data.description: Enjoy a secluded lifestyle amidst creativity and innovation at Dubai Science Park.

data.answer:
Dubai Science Park provides outstanding amenities for both residents and those working in the community. As it continuously adapts to meet the increasing need for science and innovation, the area will achieve self-sufficiency soon.

DSP provides state-of-the-art infrastructure, services, and support to foster innovation, research, and collaboration within the scientific community. It offers a range of facilities, including laboratory spaces, offices, and warehouses tailored to the needs of science-based companies.

Dubai Science Park has various high-rise buildings in the studio,1, 2, and 3-bedroom configurations. The facilities at these apartments include high-speed elevators, basement parking, a swimming pool, and 24-hour security.

Off-Plan Projects in Dubai Science Park

Binghatti Hills is the upcoming residential venture by Binghatti Developers within Dubai Science Park. Offering a selection of studio, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments, the tower showcases cutting-edge elements such as integrated smart home technology and contemporary interior design and finishes.

SkyHills Residences is another off-plan community project comprising residential units ranging from studio to 2-bedroom apartments. The two iconic towers of SkyHills Residences offer cozy living spaces.

Popular Developments in Dubai Science Park

There are various popular properties and sub-communities within Dubai Science Park. Orchid Residence Dubai Science Park is a residential development offering a selection of modern apartments for comfortable living. It provides residents with convenient access to the amenities and facilities of Dubai Science Park.

Opalz by Danube Properties is a stylish residential project offering contemporary apartments designed for modern living. The development also features amenities such as swimming pools, fitness centers, and landscaped gardens, enhancing the overall living experience for its residents. Vincotor Aqua Dimore is a luxurious development offering a range of upscale apartments and villas. Designed to exude elegance and sophistication, Vincotor Aqua Dimore provides residents with an exclusive living experience amidst lush greenery and serene surroundings.

Villa Lantana Dubai Science Park is a project by tecom Group. It offers a range of luxurious villas nestled within a green and serene environment. The community provides residents with modern amenities, lush landscaping, and a convenient location close to various attractions and facilities in Dubai.

Similarly, Montose Residences is a prestigious project offering a collection of upscale apartments and townhouses. Bella Rose Dubai Science Park is a charming residential community offering a range of beautifully designed villas and townhouses. With its picturesque setting and tranquil ambiance, Bella Rosa provides residents with a serene retreat from the hustle and bustle of city life.

Properties for Rent in Dubai Science Park 

Renting a studio in DSP can cost you as low as AED 42k, covering approximately 420 sq. ft. of floor space. Meanwhile, 1-bedroom apartments in Dubai Science Park offer a more generous living area, ranging from about 600 sq. ft. to 850 sq. ft., with annual rent starting at AED 65k.

The larger and more spacious 2-bedroom flats boast a minimum covered area of 1,200 sq. ft., with rental prices starting from AED 90k. Finally, the largest 3-bedroom apartment available for rent in Dubai Science Park spans approximately 2,300 sq. ft. and is priced at AED 120k per annum.

Properties for Sale in Dubai Science Park
If you are considering purchasing studio apartments in DSP, you can expect to pay about AED 500k minimum. Similarly, the sales prices of 1-bedroom apartments in Dubai Science Park start from AED 925k. Additionally, you can anticipate spending around AED 1.1M for a 2-bedroom flat in Dubai Science Park.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Dubai, Dubai Science Park?

data.answer:
Dubai Science Park can offer a unique and enriching experience, especially if you're passionate about science and innovation. It provides a dynamic environment where you can work, live, and thrive within a community that shares your interests and aspirations.

Public Transportation in Dubai Science Park

Dubai Science Park is in Barsha South, slightly removed from the bustling city center. Nonetheless, residents enjoy convenient access to Al Khail Road E44 and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road E311, facilitating connectivity to neighboring communities.

While private car or taxis remains the preferred mode of transportation to and from Dubai Science Park due to the absence of bus stops, bus routes F20 and F30 serve the area. The nearest metro station, Dubai Internet City Metro Station, is a 13-minute drive away.

Supermarkets in Dubai Science Park

There are various supermarkets in Dubai Science Park. Sea Sun Grocery offers a variety of everyday essentials and groceries, including fresh produce, household items, and packaged foods.

Al Madina Supermarket is also located within the community and is known for its wide range of products, including groceries, household items, personal care products, and more. It may offer a diverse selection of goods at competitive prices.

Tudo Mart is a convenience store offering a selection of groceries, snacks, beverages, and household items. LuLu Express Fresh Market is a branch of the popular LuLu Hypermarket chain, offering a wide range of fresh produce, groceries, household items, electronics, and more. It may emphasize fresh and quality products, providing residents with a comprehensive shopping experience.

Viva Supermarket JVC is a supermarket in the nearby Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) area, 15 minutes away from the community. It offers a variety of groceries, fresh produce, and household items, catering to the needs of residents in both JVC and Dubai Science Park.

Shopping in Dubai Science Park

Shopping options near Dubai Science Park are in abundance. Located just 7 minutes away, Bin Shabib Mall Al Barsha offers a range of retail stores, dining options, and entertainment facilities for residents and visitors in the area. Situated 9 minutes away, Dubai Hills Mall is a modern shopping destination featuring a wide array of retail outlets, restaurants, and family entertainment options like a multi-screen Roxy Xtreme Cinema, an Adventure Park, and a rollercoaster. Approximately 14 minutes away, Al Barsha Mall is another shopping destination offering a diverse selection of stores, eateries, and leisure activities for shoppers in the vicinity of Dubai Science Park.

Schools Near Dubai Science Park

Near Dubai Science Park, residents have access to a variety of reputable schools, offering quality education and diverse curricular options for students of all ages.

Located just 4 minutes away is Repton School Al Barsha, a renowned educational institution known for its rigorous academic programs and holistic approach to learning. With state-of-the-art facilities and experienced faculty, Repton School provides students with a nurturing environment to excel academically and develop essential life skills.

Bloom World Academy, situated just 5 minutes away, offers a dynamic learning environment focused on fostering creativity, critical thinking, and innovation. The school emphasizes personalized instruction and student-centered learning, catering to the unique needs and interests of each student.

Brighton College Dubai, a mere 6 minutes away, is esteemed for its British curriculum and commitment to academic excellence. With a strong emphasis on holistic development and extracurricular enrichment, Brighton College prepares students for success in a rapidly changing global landscape.

Kings School Al Barsha, located approximately 7 minutes away, is renowned for its comprehensive educational programs and vibrant learning community. With a focus on character development, leadership, and service, Kings School provides students with the skills and values needed to thrive in the modern world.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Dubai Science Park Area 

There are no temples or churches directly in the area, but within a 15-minute distance, one can find the Fellowship Church and Yalcin Malikanesi Church in the Al Sufouh area. Additionally, The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints in the Al Safa community is approximately 20 minutes away.

The nearest temples are located about 30 minutes away in Al Raffa, Bur Dubai. These include the Shrinath Ji Temple, Shiva Temple, and Shree Krishna Haveli, which are highly frequented by the Hindu community. The Mahamevnawa Buddhist Temple, the only Buddhist temple in the UAE, can be reached in around 20 to 25 minutes in Jumeirah 1.

Furthermore, several mosques are located near Dubai Science Park, such as the Fatima Buti Atiq Mosque, Masjid Abu Bukar Al Siddiq Mosque, Khalfan Bin Shannaf Mosque, Masjid Al Hussein Ali Yateem, and Ali-Al Haj Mosque.

Clinics and Hospitals in Dubai Science Park Dubai

Located in the southern part of Al Barsha, this area is also host to two specialized hospitals: the NeuroSpinal Hospital and Mediclinic Parkview Hospital. The latter focuses particularly on family medicine, obstetrics and gynecology, and pediatrics.

For medical care in the neighborhood of Motor City, residents can reach Medcare Medical Centre and Emirates Hospital, both situated just 9 minutes away.

Al Zahra Hospital and Saudi German Hospital are also available, albeit at a slightly farther distance of 15 minutes from the community. Nearby clinics include City Centre Clinic, reachable within a 3-minute drive, and Aster Clinic, Al Barsha, located approximately 13 minutes away. Additionally, Dermapath Consult is conveniently located within Dubai Science Park itself.

Residents have access to numerous pharmacies in the area. Marina Pharmacy is situated towards the south of the community, while two branches of Aster Pharmacy are available in Barsha South, ensuring convenient access to medications and healthcare essentials.

Dubai Science Park Location & Nearby Areas

Dubai Science Park is strategically situated in the vibrant Al Barsha South district, offering residents and businesses a dynamic environment conducive to innovation and growth. Surrounded by key areas such as Motor City, Al Sufouh, and Dubai Sports City, Dubai Science Park enjoys proximity to a diverse range of amenities and attractions.

Residents benefit from easy access to major roadways, including Al Khail Road (E44) and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), facilitating seamless travel to neighboring communities and beyond. With its central location and convenient connectivity, Dubai Science Park is a hub for scientific research, technological advancements, and sustainable living in the heart of Dubai.

more_info.question: Things to Do In and Near Dubai Science Park

data.answer:
Residents of Dubai Science Park can take part in many activities. You can find malls, restaurants, and tourist attractions in proximity to your residence.

Restaurants In and Near Dubai Science Park Dubai

The vicinity offers a wide array of dining options, catering to various tastes and budgets. Within a 10-minute radius from DSP, one can find popular eateries like Popeyes, Wendy’s, Shakespeare and Co Dubai Science Park, and The Noodle House. Additionally, establishments are serving authentic Arabic, Indian, and Syrian cuisines, such as Saj 2 Go, Marmarita Restaurant, Bazerkan Lebanese Restaurant, and Achha Baba Restaurant, are all conveniently located a short drive away. Al Nile Gourmet is 5 minutes from Dubai Science Park, while Drip Burgers 1, Al Barsha South, is  3 minutes away.

Beaches Near Dubai Science Park

If you're seeking nearby beaches from Dubai Science Park, Al Sufouh Beach, nestled between two iconic city landmarks - Burj Al Arab and Palm Jumeirah, can be reached within a 15-minute drive. Just two minutes further is the renowned Jumeirah Beach.

Hotels In and Near the Dubai Science Park Dubai Area

Holiday Inn Dubai Science Park is a contemporary hotel in the heart of Dubai's vibrant Science Park community. It offers convenient access to major transportation routes, business hubs, and key attractions in Dubai.

Dubai Science Park Hotels in the Al Barsha Dubai area include The S Hotel Al Barsha Dubai. Situated in the vibrant Al Barsha district, the hotel is known for its elegant design, spacious rooms, and excellent dining options. Guests can enjoy facilities such as a rooftop pool, fitness center, and multiple dining outlets, making it an ideal choice for both business and leisure travelers.

Located within a short driving distance, M Hotel Downtown by Millennium offers upscale accommodations with panoramic views of the city skyline. The hotel features well-appointed rooms, a rooftop pool, a fitness center, and several dining options. Its central location provides easy access to Dubai's key attractions, making it a convenient choice for travelers exploring the city.

Media Rotana Dubai is a luxury hotel offering sophisticated accommodations and world-class amenities. Situated in the heart of Dubai's bustling Al Barsha district, the hotel boasts stylish rooms, award-winning restaurants, a state-of-the-art fitness center, and a temperature-controlled outdoor pool. With its warm hospitality and convenient location, Media Rotana Dubai provides an unforgettable stay experience for guests.

Hilton Dubai Al Barsha is another renowned hotel offering upscale accommodations and impeccable service. Located in the vibrant Al Barsha district, the hotel features spacious rooms, multiple dining options, a rooftop pool, and a fully equipped fitness center. Its prime location near Dubai Science Park makes it a popular choice for both business and leisure travelers seeking comfort and convenience.

Attractions and Landmarks Near Dubai Science Park

The DSP headquarters is characterized by its twin wedge-shaped buildings that stand out prominently in the skyline. The area is conveniently located near the D63 Umm Suqeim Road, offering easy access to Motor City, where attractions like the Dubai Autodrome and a growing array of shopping and dining options await. The area also boasts the Park Inn Radisson Hotel.

Attractions and landmarks near Dubai Science Park include the Dubai Butterfly Garden. This unique attraction features thousands of butterflies housed in a climate-controlled dome. The garden also includes educational exhibits and interactive displays, making it enjoyable for visitors of all ages.

Dubai Miracle Garden is one of the world's largest flower gardens, showcasing an impressive collection of floral displays and installations. Visitors can explore intricately designed landscapes adorned with millions of blooming flowers, including elaborate sculptures and structures crafted entirely from flowers. The garden offers a picturesque setting for leisurely walks, photography, and relaxation amidst nature's beauty. Both of these attractions are within a 5-minute driving distance.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

There are several parks in the vicinity of Dubai Science Park, with the neighboring JVC community being a particularly recommended destination. Within JVC, visitors can explore various parks, including Khansoor Park, JVC Castle Park, and the Circle Community Park.

Nearby, Grand Flora Salon and Red Door Salon are just a 3-minute drive from DSP, offering convenient options for beauty services. Additionally, the renowned Dollhouse Beauty Salon is reachable within a 7-minute drive. Other nearby salons include Senses, Karz Beauty Salon, and Better Beauty Salon.

For those looking to stay active, several gyms can be reached within a short drive, including DuGym Gymnastics Club, Prime Fitness JVC, and R Boot Camp. These facilities provide convenient options for fitness enthusiasts in the area.

One disadvantage of living in Dubai Science Park is its distance from the city center. While this provides a quieter and more peaceful living environment, it may also result in longer commute times for residents who work or frequently visit downtown areas.

What is Dubai Science Park Dubai United Arab Emirates?

Dubai Science Park is a free zone community located in the heart of Dubai, dedicated to fostering innovation, research, and development in the fields of science, technology, and sustainability. It is a vibrant hub for businesses, entrepreneurs, and professionals seeking to collaborate and drive advancements in various industries.

What industries are represented in Dubai Science Park?

There are many companies in Dubai Science Park from various industries, including pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, healthcare, energy, environmental sustainability, and information technology. It provides specialized infrastructure and facilities tailored to the needs of these sectors. The top Dubai Science Park companies are Pfizer, Medtronic, Olympus, Alliance Global Dubai Science Park, Mettler Toledo, Agiomix Dubai Science Park, and First Solar.

Dubai Science Park headquarters is also located within the park itself. The headquarters serves as the administrative hub for the park's operations, including managing leases, facilitating partnerships, organizing events, and providing support services to the companies and organizations within the park.

How can I set up my business in Dubai Science Park?

Setting up a business in Dubai Science Park involves registering with the relevant authorities and obtaining the necessary permits and licenses. The process may vary depending on the type of business and legal structure. Companies interested in establishing a presence in DSP can contact the park management for assistance and guidance through the setup process.

What amenities and facilities are available in Dubai Science Park free zone?

Dubai Science Park offers a wide range of amenities and facilities to support its community, including modern office spaces, laboratories, research centers, incubation facilities, meeting rooms, and conference facilities. The park also features green spaces, recreational areas, dining options, and retail outlets.

Is Dubai Science Park open to the public?

While Dubai Science Park primarily caters to businesses and professionals in the science and technology sectors, certain facilities and amenities may be open to the public, such as retail outlets, dining establishments, and recreational areas. However, access to specific areas may be restricted to authorized personnel only.

Does the community host any events?

Yes, many events take place in the area, from the Dubai Science Park career fair to training sessions and meetings to workshops and conferences related to science and innovation.

data.content:
The science-focused district, Dubai Science Park, is located in Al Barsha South. The business community has more than 350 energy, science, and technology companies. It focuses on facilitating small-to-medium enterprises (SMEs) and multinational companies.

In addition to the commercial properties, the area offers residential apartments. Set along Umm Suqeim Road, the flats are available for sale and rent. In addition to housing options, the community features a state-of-the-art headquarters with twin towers, an environmentally sustainable laboratory complex, and two warehouses dedicated to research and development.

The Freezone community is easily accessible through Al Khail Road E44 and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road E311. Living near Dubai Science Park provides access to amenities such as schools, shopping malls, recreational facilities, and green spaces in the surrounding areas.
